title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Warriors
The prison takes on a military style feel for both the inmates and the officers; a gang unit investigation turns up the heat on a pair of cellmates, before one of them turns on the other.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — The Hustle
Prison is an underground economy, where some deals are signed in ink and others are signed in blood; a rare look at the schemes, hustles and extortions conducted behind prison walls and the consequences they carry.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Red and Whites
A group of prisoners are entrusted with potential weapons, but for the benefit of others; one of them hopes this assignment will result in a life-long bond; back at the jail, an inmate brawl leaves several officers injured.

title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Tipped Off
At Indiana State Prison, visitation is a valued privilege for inmates, but it can also be abused; it's the most common route for contraband to enter the prison; an anonymous tip has put Internal Affairs on high alert.

title: Lockup: Indiana: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Cutting
From the most trusted inmates, working at the prison barbershop, to inmate assaults on prison staff, or inmates who turn violence against themselves, at Indiana State Prison, "cutting" has many meanings.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Purple Pain
Deputies respond to a possible gang beating, but the surveillance cameras don't catch anything; a wounded warrior faces a new battle when he and his girlfriend both get arrested.

title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Taming Wild
A family man gets a decade in jail for manufacturing weapons; a meth addict gives up a prized possession; jail introduces both of these men to a cowboy, some wild horses and the opportunity of a lifetime.

title: Lockup: Boston: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Blood Brothers
An inmate takes his fights from the street to the halls of the jail and his boyhood friend follows his example; two brothers turn to crime to support their habits and one faces the prospect of hitting the streets again.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — The Wrong Fight
A new arrival in the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution raises serious concerns throughout the maximum-security prison; young correctional officer cadets experience the burn as each one takes a pepper spray shot in the eye.
